008package convert;
009
010import java.nio.file.Path;
011import java.util.*;
012
013/**
014 * Specialized converter for the experiment metadata table.
015 */
016public final class ExperimentInfoConverter {
017
018    private final Path inputFile;
019    private final Path outputFile;
020
021    public ExperimentInfoConverter(Path inputDir) {
022        this.inputFile = inputDir.resolve("Experiment Info - Python.csv");
023        this.outputFile = inputDir.resolve("Experiment Info.csv");
024    }
025
026    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
027    // FINAL new header order (column 3)
028    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
029    private static final List<String> HEADER = Arrays.asList(
030            "Experiment Name",
031            "Recording Name",
032            "Condition Number",
033            "Replicate Number",
034            "Probe Name",
035            "Probe Type",
036            "Cell Type",
037            "Adjuvant",
038            "Concentration",
039            "Process Flag",
040            "Threshold"
041    );
042
043    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
044    // NEW COLUMN → OLD POSITION (column 4)
045    // (1-based indexes, because Python export is 1-based)
046    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
047    private static final Map<String,Integer> INDEX_MAP = new LinkedHashMap<>();
048    static {
049        INDEX_MAP.put("Experiment Name",     4);
050        INDEX_MAP.put("Recording Name",      2);
051        INDEX_MAP.put("Condition Number",    5);
052        INDEX_MAP.put("Replicate Number",    6);
053        INDEX_MAP.put("Probe Name",          7);
054        INDEX_MAP.put("Probe Type",          8);
055        INDEX_MAP.put("Cell Type",           9);
056        INDEX_MAP.put("Adjuvant",           10);
057        INDEX_MAP.put("Concentration",      11);
058        INDEX_MAP.put("Process Flag",       13);
059        INDEX_MAP.put("Threshold",          12);
060    }
061
062    public List<Map<String,String>> convert(List<Map<String,String>> src) {
063
064        List<Map<String,String>> out = new ArrayList<>();
065
066        for (Map<String,String> inRow : src) {
067
068            // convert old row to array by index
069            String[] raw = inRow.values().toArray(new String[inRow.size()]);
070
071            Map<String,String> row = new LinkedHashMap<>();
072
073            for (String newCol : HEADER) {
074                int oldPos = INDEX_MAP.get(newCol);
075                int idx = oldPos - 1;  // convert to 0-based
076                String val = (idx < raw.length ? raw[idx] : "");
077                row.put(newCol, val == null ? "" : val.trim());
078            }
079
080            out.add(row);
081        }
082
083        return out;
084    }
085
086    public void run() throws Exception {
087        System.out.println("Reading:  " + inputFile);
088        List<Map<String,String>> src = CsvIO.readSimpleCsv(inputFile);
089
090        System.out.println("Converting Experiment Info...");
091        List<Map<String,String>> out = convert(src);
092
093        System.out.println("Writing:  " + outputFile);
094        CsvIO.writeSimpleCsv(outputFile, HEADER, out);
095
096        System.out.println("✔ Experiment Info conversion complete.");
097    }
098
099    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
100        Path dir = Path.of("/Users/hans/Downloads/221012 Python Reference - v39");
101        new ExperimentInfoConverter(dir).run();
102    }
103}
